BiblicalUsage: Pishtah is flax, the plant, and the tow it becomes. The flax of Egypt was smitten in the hail in Exodus 9:31, and Isaiah 43:17 says the army is quenched as tow. But Isaiah 42:3 promises the Servant will not quench the smoking flax — the weakest wick is safe in His hands.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the smoking flax is me on my weakest day, and the Servant will not put me out.
